description: Sandbox toolchain resolution follows the warren server's PATH (src/sandbox/env.ts prepends each resolved binary's bin dir): on a nix-managed macOS host, nix-store git resolved first but its dylibs live outside the sandbox-exec profile's readable paths, so every in-run git call died with dyld 'Library not loaded' and the run reaped failed/dropped_commit AFTER spending model tokens.
resolution: Boot warren with /usr/bin ahead of nix paths on PATH so Apple git resolves into the sandbox toolchain; durable fix is the in-sandbox git preflight (pl-26f3 step 6, warren-1219).

name: sandbox-git-preflight
description: Sandbox git preflight (warren-1219): probeSandboxGit in src/sandbox/git-preflight.ts runs 'git --version' through runSandboxed with a minimal profile mirroring resolveToolchainPaths' git toolchain mounts; wired into doctor --local (probe injected via DoctorDeps, hermetic by default) and addProject (optional sandboxGitPreflight, throws SandboxGitPreflightError -> HTTP 503). macOS substitution exports WARREN_SANDBOX_GIT, honored by resolveToolchainPaths via resolveBinaryPath; probe skips ok when the bwrap/sandbox-exec wrapper is missing so the wrapper check stays the single signal.
